what.text: This page follows refugees from Oman in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 133 Omani refugees, and the United Kingdom hosted 56.4% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are the United States, Germany and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Oman, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1994 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
